description: The Aimplan Edit Table delivers a Power BI-native user experience for data editing and management.. Edit account groupings, product hierarchies, project registers, currency rates, and other structural data directly on a report page and write it back to storage immediately, with no upload step and no manual synchronization. Owners of the business logic can maintain the data they are responsible for without going through IT and without leaving Power BI. Changes are reflected across every downstream report and planning form the moment they are saved. Key capabilities: full respect for slicers and row-level security, calculated columns, drill-through and modern tooltips, lock-measure support, and display of calculated values alongside editable data. An Aimplan license and access to an Aimplan environment are required to use the data write-back functionality of this visual. To learn more about Aimplan, visit www.aimplan.com or schedule a demo at https://www.aimplan.com/demo.
